opening.argument: The stated offer is a retail recycling trade-in: customers bring a used car seat to the service desk of a participating Walmart store and receive a $30 Walmart gift card. The footage is consistent with that account, showing a car seat in a shopping cart and a Walmart Services counter. Those details support an ordinary store promotion, not a separate request for payment or a promise of further returns. The closing request to subscribe is channel engagement; it is not presented as a condition for receiving the gift card or taking part in the trade-in.

citations.quote: Customers can trade in used car seats at the Service desk in any participating Walmart store and receive a $30 Walmart gift card*
